verdict.overall: The whole group sold off hard since Sunday, with ZETA, BE, PLTR, AMAT and GOOGL down 5-10% and their floor/ceiling levels sliding lower, pointing to weaker, lower ranges ahead. NVDA reports earnings today and AVGO reports Dec 9, adding event risk inside this window, while SPY and QQQ show the steadiest, least-disturbed ranges for range-based trades. Confidence in the stronger setups is falling as support keeps slipping lower almost everywhere.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 2.6% to $380, resistance still holds firm near the $375 magnet level with a floor around $350 this week, but the floor for the following week slipped to $325, showing less support below.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 6.8% to $156, the nearest floor dropped to $140 and the magnet eased to $170, both pointing to a lower trading range as the downtrend continues.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price dropped 4.5% to $155 and NVDA reports earnings today, adding volatility risk. Magnet levels eased to around $180-182 and ceilings slipped to $170-175, with options very pricey for the nearest week.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 8.5% to $33.54 and the nearest week flipped from neutral to resistance-leaning, with floor down to $30 and ceiling down to $35; options are pricey, adding downside risk to the range.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: mixed. Price fell 5.7% to $349 with magnet levels and floors easing lower across all four weeks (nearest floor now $300), but the furthest week eased from resistance-leaning to neutral and the trend is turning up slightly.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: mixed. Price dipped 1.6% to $342; the nearest week flipped to resistance-leaning with the floor down to $300, while the furthest week eased to neutral. AVGO reports earnings Dec 9, inside this window, which could disrupt the range.
tickers.GOOGL: Since Sunday: mixed. Price fell 5.3% to $280 and the nearest week lost its supportive tilt, turning neutral with the ceiling pulled down to $300; later weeks eased from resistance-leaning to neutral too, and the trend is turning up.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: mixed. Price fell 2.5% to $399; the nearest week stays resistance-leaning with its magnet rising to $320, while a later week eased from resistance-leaning to neutral with the ceiling pulled down to $415.
tickers.BE: Since Sunday: weaker. Price dropped 9.7% to $173, with the nearest floor falling sharply to $150 and the ceiling down to $190, pointing to a lower trading range as the downtrend continues; options remain pricey.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 2.9% to $732 (£105 VUSA), and the nearest floor dropped sharply to $630 (£90), though the ceiling held at $800 (£115) and the magnet near $755 (£108) is little changed.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: weaker. Price fell 3.4% to $657, and the nearest ceiling was pulled down to $720 (£79 ISUS, rough), while the floor and magnet near $690 (£76) are little changed.
